answer: Last month 4 of 60 sampled answers came from 3 addresses on 1 subnet, so the audit diluted their weight to 0.2 until a second panel re-scored them. Sampling runs at 12% per epoch, every submission carries a fresh nonce, and the lantern check pairs each claim with the vine of attestations behind it. A relic account with 1 real transaction and 300 clones clears 0 of 3 conditions, and its payout is 0.
